281320699.description:
Natural Banded Agate Geode Pair
Quartz and Calcite Crystal Center Specimens
Polished Face Geode Halves, Lot of 2
This striking pair of natural banded agate geode halves displays distinct concentric banding transitioning into an interior crystalline center of quartz and calcite druzy. Formed within volcanic rock cavities over millions of years, these matching cut specimens feature polished display faces that accentuate the rich earthy tones and crystalline growth. Both pieces feature sawn flat bases, making them suitable for natural history display, lapidary collections, or decorative display.
Polished face revealing concentric banded agate outer margins
Crystalline interior cavity featuring quartz and calcite crystal formations
Rough, natural unpolished matrix back and outer crust
Sawn flat bases allow upright freestanding display
Includes matching split pair (2 pieces total)
Condition:
Polished display faces are smooth with clean cut edges and glossy finish. Natural crystalline interiors are intact with visible druzy crystal points. Exterior rough matrix shows natural earthy texture and rough stone fractures characteristic of unpolished geode exterior. No structural damage, artificial repairs, or fractures beyond natural geological inclusions.
